content.json:
# Orchestrator jobs on Logic Apps
Business view first, technical detail below. **Patterns:** 1 Partner transfer (J1, J2), 2 File share (J4, J5), 3 Hybrid worker (J3). Click a run in a table to see its steps from Application Insights at the bottom.

content.query:
let JobNames = datatable(WorkflowName:string, Job:string, Pattern:string) [
    "wf-j1-partner-ftp-to-sftp", "J1 Partner A to partner B", "1 Partner transfer",
    "wf-j2-ftp-to-sharepoint", "J2 Partner A to SharePoint", "1 Partner transfer",
    "wf-j4-ftp-sort-to-nas", "J4 Partner files to NAS folders", "2 File share",
    "wf-j5-nas-folderwatch", "J5 NAS folder watch", "2 File share",
    "wf-j3-convert-onprem", "J3 Convert files on a server", "3 Hybrid worker"];
let Runs = LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where OperationName == "WorkflowRunCompleted"
    | join kind=inner JobNames on WorkflowName;
let Summaries = LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where OperationName == "WorkflowActionCompleted" and Status == "Succeeded"
    | where ActionName == "Compose_summary" or ActionName startswith "Track_runbook_" or ActionName in ("Track_timeout", "Track_terminal_failure", "Track_missing_runbook_output")
    | extend T = parse_json(tostring(TrackedProperties))
    | join kind=inner JobNames on WorkflowName
    | project TimeGenerated, RunId, Job, Pattern,
        Processed = toint(T.filesProcessed), Skipped = toint(T.filesSkipped), Failed = toint(T.filesFailed),
        Worker = tostring(T.worker), ErrorCode = tostring(T.errorCode);
let RunCounts = Runs | summarize Runs = count(), Succeeded = countif(Status == "Succeeded"), FailedRuns = countif(Status == "Failed");
let FileCounts = Summaries | summarize Delivered = sum(Processed), Skipped = sum(Skipped);
RunCounts | extend Dummy = 1 | join kind=inner (FileCounts | extend Dummy = 1) on Dummy
| project Metric = pack_array("Runs", "Success rate", "Failed runs", "Files delivered", "Duplicates skipped"),
          Value = pack_array(tostring(Runs), strcat(tostring(round(100.0 * Succeeded / Runs, 1)), " %"), tostring(FailedRuns), tostring(Delivered), tostring(Skipped))
| mv-expand Metric to typeof(string), Value to typeof(string)
content.title: Overview

content.query:
let JobNames = datatable(WorkflowName:string, Job:string, Pattern:string) [
    "wf-j1-partner-ftp-to-sftp", "J1 Partner A to partner B", "1 Partner transfer",
    "wf-j2-ftp-to-sharepoint", "J2 Partner A to SharePoint", "1 Partner transfer",
    "wf-j4-ftp-sort-to-nas", "J4 Partner files to NAS folders", "2 File share",
    "wf-j5-nas-folderwatch", "J5 NAS folder watch", "2 File share",
    "wf-j3-convert-onprem", "J3 Convert files on a server", "3 Hybrid worker"];
let Runs = LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where OperationName == "WorkflowRunCompleted"
    | join kind=inner JobNames on WorkflowName;
let Summaries = LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where OperationName == "WorkflowActionCompleted" and Status == "Succeeded"
    | where ActionName == "Compose_summary" or ActionName startswith "Track_runbook_" or ActionName in ("Track_timeout", "Track_terminal_failure", "Track_missing_runbook_output")
    | extend T = parse_json(tostring(TrackedProperties))
    | join kind=inner JobNames on WorkflowName
    | project TimeGenerated, RunId, Job, Pattern,
        Processed = toint(T.filesProcessed), Skipped = toint(T.filesSkipped), Failed = toint(T.filesFailed),
        Worker = tostring(T.worker), ErrorCode = tostring(T.errorCode);
let RunStats = Runs | summarize Runs = count(), Succeeded = countif(Status == "Succeeded"), Failed = countif(Status == "Failed"), LastRun = max(EndTime) by Job, Pattern;
let LastSuccess = Runs | where Status == "Succeeded" | summarize LastSuccess = max(EndTime) by Job;
let Files = Summaries | summarize FilesDelivered = sum(Processed), DuplicatesSkipped = sum(Skipped), FilesFailed = sum(Failed) by Job;
RunStats
| join kind=leftouter LastSuccess on Job
| join kind=leftouter Files on Job
| project Pattern, Job, Runs, ["Success %"] = round(100.0 * Succeeded / Runs, 1), Failed, FilesDelivered = coalesce(FilesDelivered, 0), DuplicatesSkipped = coalesce(DuplicatesSkipped, 0), FilesFailed = coalesce(FilesFailed, 0), LastSuccess, LastRun
| order by Pattern asc, Job asc
content.title: Per job: runs, success rate, files and last success

content.query:
let JobNames = datatable(WorkflowName:string, Job:string, Pattern:string) [
    "wf-j1-partner-ftp-to-sftp", "J1 Partner A to partner B", "1 Partner transfer",
    "wf-j2-ftp-to-sharepoint", "J2 Partner A to SharePoint", "1 Partner transfer",
    "wf-j4-ftp-sort-to-nas", "J4 Partner files to NAS folders", "2 File share",
    "wf-j5-nas-folderwatch", "J5 NAS folder watch", "2 File share",
    "wf-j3-convert-onprem", "J3 Convert files on a server", "3 Hybrid worker"];
let Runs = LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where OperationName == "WorkflowRunCompleted"
    | join kind=inner JobNames on WorkflowName;
let Summaries = LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where OperationName == "WorkflowActionCompleted" and Status == "Succeeded"
    | where ActionName == "Compose_summary" or ActionName startswith "Track_runbook_" or ActionName in ("Track_timeout", "Track_terminal_failure", "Track_missing_runbook_output")
    | extend T = parse_json(tostring(TrackedProperties))
    | join kind=inner JobNames on WorkflowName
    | project TimeGenerated, RunId, Job, Pattern,
        Processed = toint(T.filesProcessed), Skipped = toint(T.filesSkipped), Failed = toint(T.filesFailed),
        Worker = tostring(T.worker), ErrorCode = tostring(T.errorCode);
let Codes = Summaries | where isnotempty(ErrorCode) | project RunId, ErrorCode;
// The first failed step of each run, leaving out containers (scopes, loops) and the lookups that fail by design (NotFound).
let FirstFailedStep = LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where OperationName == "WorkflowActionCompleted" and Status == "Failed"
    | where Code !in ("ActionFailed", "NotFound")
    | summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, ActionName, Code) by RunId
    | project RunId, FailedStep = ActionName, StepCode = Code;
Runs
| where Status == "Failed"
| join kind=leftouter Codes on RunId
| join kind=leftouter FirstFailedStep on RunId
| extend Reason = case(
    ErrorCode == "HYBRID_JOB_TIMEOUT", "No hybrid worker picked up the job in time (worker offline?)",
    ErrorCode == "RUNBOOK_REPORTED_FAILURE", "The tool on the server reported a problem with a file or the share",
    WorkflowName in ("wf-j4-ftp-sort-to-nas", "wf-j5-nas-folderwatch") and (FailedStep startswith "Check_NAS" or FailedStep in ("Get_target_metadata", "Create_new_file", "Create_conflict_file", "List_watch_folder", "Copy_to_processed")), "NAS file share unreachable",
    StepCode == "BadRequest" and FailedStep == "List_source_files", "Partner refused the login (wrong credentials?)",
    StepCode in ("BadGateway", "GatewayTimeout") and FailedStep in ("List_source_files", "Get_source_content", "Upload_partial", "Rename_to_final"), "Partner server unreachable (IP not allow-listed or server down?)",
    isnotempty(FailedStep), strcat("Step ", FailedStep, " failed (", StepCode, ")"),
    "Open the run for details")
| project EndTime, Pattern, Job, Reason, Step = FailedStep, RunId
| order by EndTime desc
content.title: Failed runs, in plain words (click a row for its steps)

content.query:
let JobNames = datatable(WorkflowName:string, Job:string, Pattern:string) [
    "wf-j1-partner-ftp-to-sftp", "J1 Partner A to partner B", "1 Partner transfer",
    "wf-j2-ftp-to-sharepoint", "J2 Partner A to SharePoint", "1 Partner transfer",
    "wf-j4-ftp-sort-to-nas", "J4 Partner files to NAS folders", "2 File share",
    "wf-j5-nas-folderwatch", "J5 NAS folder watch", "2 File share",
    "wf-j3-convert-onprem", "J3 Convert files on a server", "3 Hybrid worker"];
let Summaries = LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where OperationName == "WorkflowActionCompleted" and Status == "Succeeded"
    | where ActionName == "Compose_summary" or ActionName startswith "Track_runbook_" or ActionName in ("Track_timeout", "Track_terminal_failure", "Track_missing_runbook_output")
    | extend T = parse_json(tostring(TrackedProperties))
    | join kind=inner JobNames on WorkflowName
    | project TimeGenerated, RunId, Job, Pattern,
        Processed = toint(T.filesProcessed), Skipped = toint(T.filesSkipped), Failed = toint(T.filesFailed),
        Worker = tostring(T.worker), ErrorCode = tostring(T.errorCode);
let Jobs = AzureDiagnostics
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where Category == "JobLogs" and ResultType in ("Completed", "Failed", "Suspended", "Stopped")
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, ResultType) by JobId = tostring(JobId_g);
let Workers = LogicAppWorkflowRuntime
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where ActionName == "Track_runbook_success"
    | extend T = parse_json(tostring(TrackedProperties))
    | project JobId = tostring(T.automationJobId), Worker = tostring(T.worker);
Jobs
| join kind=leftouter Workers on JobId
| summarize Jobs = count() by Status = ResultType, Worker = iff(isempty(Worker), "(no result)", Worker)
| order by Jobs desc
content.title: Automation jobs by status and worker

content.query:
let Run = '{RunId}';
union
    (AppRequests | where OperationId == Run | project TimeGenerated, Kind = "Step", Name, Success, ResultCode, DurationMs, Detail = ""),
    (AppDependencies | where OperationId == Run | project TimeGenerated, Kind = "Connector call", Name = strcat(Type, " ", Name), Success, ResultCode, DurationMs, Detail = Target),
    (AppExceptions | where OperationId == Run | project TimeGenerated, Kind = "Exception", Name = ProblemId, Success = false, ResultCode = "", DurationMs = real(null), Detail = OuterMessage)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Steps of run {RunId} (Application Insights)
